chunks: Or do they say: 'He has fabricated it?' In fact, they will never believe.

key_terms.تَقَوَّلَهُ: He fabricated it / He invented it

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Am yaqooluna taqawwalahu' in Surah At-Tur?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Tur, this verse highlights the psychological root of the Meccan disbelievers' denial, attributing their rejection of the Quran's divine origin not to logical deficiency but to a hardened spiritual state. Shia exegetes often link this 'lack of belief' to the concept of *al-Iman al-Jaz'i* (convictive faith), suggesting that true recognition of the Prophet's message requires an internal openness that their stubbornness (*istikbar*) blocked. This connects the external accusation of fabrication (*taqawwal*) with the internal reality of their disbelief.
